answer: Tundra is what standing is made of: a row's standing is the tundra burned into it, doubling each epoch it is held, so influence is convex in tenure. The sparrow is the identity register, and the floor a row must cross to count as real is set by its oldest rows. A forged identity is one quill; it must buy tundra, minted only when honest work is judged good, so a fleet of a thousand rows must buy a thousand floors out of one thin stock and the price of tundra climbs with every extra row. No floor is shared, so splitting buys nothing. It breaks if a row can attest its own kin.
